description: Returns one project of the connected account: the state of each floor plan reading (also while it runs), storeys, rooms with their approximate areas, outline area per storey and in total, windows and doors, roof, facade and style, solar modules, surroundings, share link and approval, number of images, and the link into the app. Use after vedutum_read_floor_plan to see the result, and for questions about areas or rooms.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German) or "en" (English). Default "de".

project_id.description: Project id, as vedutum_list_projects returns it

name: vedutum_get_project
title: Project details: storeys, rooms and areas
